page_title.en: Tildy's Tailor Shop — Measure with a Ruler

page_intro.en: Help Tildy measure ribbons and cords: slide the ruler so its 0 lines up with the start of the strip, then read the number at the other end. Knot the cat keeps nudging the ruler, so YOU place it — if you start at the 1 instead of the 0, it reads one short. Common Core 2.MD.A.1.

rounds.prompt: Measure the ribbon. Slide the ruler so 0 is at the start, then read the end.
Measure the leather strip. Line up 0 with the start.
Measure the yarn. Put 0 at the start — not the 1!
Measure the cord. Slide the 0 to the start, then read the end.
Measure the wide ribbon. 0 at the start, read the far end.
The ruler is broken — it starts at 2! Count the cm-marks the strip covers.
Tildy got 5, but the ribbon is longer. What went wrong?
This strip is long! Pick a ruler that reaches all the way.
Pick a tool long enough to measure this strip.
